description: samTrans_bus_routes_20151021_shapes is a dataset listed in County of San Mateo open data portal (data.smcgov.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by County of San Mateo. San Mateo County bus route network created from samTrans General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) data. Coverage: San Mateo County, California. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are transit, bus, bus routes. The table has 16 columns. Attribution on the portal: samTrans. The portal shows 2015-10-21 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-smcgov-org-portal.
